What is live and what is not

Real screenshots from the Android emulator, with the BFF in proxy mode against a stand-in backend. Numbers match the notes beside each screen.

Live from the backendFixed text, or does nothing yetFrom the app buildNot wired to the backend

Dashboard: top

Name, trend, banner and the setup checklist are computed from the backend.

  1. 1Menu button opens the drawer. The drawer itself is fixed.
  2. 2Search icon: does nothing yet.
  3. 3Title: first name from GET /profile.
  4. 4Subtitle: "net worth up $X" from the saved net-worth history (GET/POST /history/net_worth).
  5. 5Banner: a bank that needs re-login, from the "errors" in GET /plaid/classified-accounts.
  6. 6"Accept the agreements" and "Set up billing" are always shown as done, same as the web app.
  7. 7"Answer the questionnaire" comes from GET /legal/status.
  8. 8"Add your contact details": GET /legal/beta-contact (404 means not done).
  9. 9"Build your financial profile" (GET /profile) and "Connect your first account" (GET /plaid/classified-accounts).
  10. 10Progress bar and "83% complete" are counted from those six steps.
  11. 11Bottom tabs: fixed labels and icons; they only switch screens.

Dashboard: Game Plan and net worth

The Game Plan comes from the web app's rules engine; net worth from your accounts and history.

  1. 1Top priority: from the rules engine (POST /api/recommendation on the web app).
  2. 2Allocation bars: the six percentages from the same rules engine.
  3. 3Footnote: rule version is live (GBF-ALLOC-1.1); the legal sentence is fixed text.
  4. 4Net worth value: assets minus liabilities from GET /plaid/classified-accounts.
  5. 5"+$3,300 vs last month": from the net-worth history.
  6. 6"Trend" hint: tapping it does nothing yet (the trend chart is not built).

Dashboard: lower tiles

Each tile is a value from the backend; some labels are fixed.

  1. 1Wellness score 53: from the rules engine.
  2. 2"+5 pts vs last month": from the wellness history.
  3. 3"Why 53?": tapping does nothing yet (the score breakdown is not built).
  4. 4Savings rate 12%: from the rules engine, based on the saved profile.
  5. 5Caption "Of monthly take-home pay" is fixed text.
  6. 6Assets $17,500: the sum of asset accounts.
  7. 7"2 accounts tracked": a count of those accounts.
  8. 8Liabilities $3,000: the sum of card and loan balances.

Menu drawer

Navigation is fixed; only the version comes from the build.

  1. 1Menu items and icons: fixed. They only switch screens.
  2. 2Log out: does nothing yet. The hook exists; you will tell me what it should do.
  3. 3"v1.0.0 · TEST": from the build (version and TEST/PROD flavor).
